Welcome to Antivirus Expert – your trusted virus scanner, storage cleaner and file manager.

KEY FEATURES
✅ Virus Scanner: Scan all installed apps and local files to detect and remove viruses.
✅ Junk Cleaner: One tap to scan and clean junk files.
✅ Large File Cleanup: Identify bulky files taking up storage space and delete unwanted large files in bulk with one tap.
✅ Media File Manager: Easily browse, select and delete your pictures, videos and audio files.
✅ Duplicate Photo Finder: Automatically detect identical or similar photos.
✅ Image Compression Tool: Compress pictures to save space.
✅ App Manager: View storage usage of each app, and uninstall unused apps.
✅ Photo Privacy Cleaner: Remove location information from the photo.

Have questions? Contact us at: donijane483@gmail.com
